Denis DiBlasio leads an active career as a baritone saxophonist, flautist, composer, and jazz educator. He is the Executive Director of the Maynard Ferguson Institute of Jazz and head of the jazz and composition programs at Rowan University.
Denis was interviewed in Clinton, New York on May 1, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we’re in the Fillius Jazz Archive with Denis DiBlasio, monstrous baritone saxophonist and jazz educator.
I already don’t like where this is going.
Okay. Well we’ll see if we can get better.
You know I appreciate the fact that you’ve been sort of walking around this space and ooing and aahing. Like you’ve got the lineage and you know.
Oh this is holy ground here.
